title: Engagement or roka cake near Box Hill or Rouse Hill? 100% eggless, Riverstone
summary:
Roka or engagement party in Box Hill or Rouse Hill? Every cake we bake is 100% eggless, so nobody has to ask.

Two families, one cake, no ingredient questions. That matters when the guest list runs from Nani to the groom's workmates, with vegetarian and Jain relatives somewhere in between.

A 10-inch serves 20-22 from $74.99. A 12-inch serves 25-30 from $89.99. 15 flavours, Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher included. Buttercream, fondant or ganache, both names piped on, or send us a photo of the design you have in mind 💍

Two days' notice. Pickup from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking, a short drive from Box Hill and Rouse Hill.

The ring took months to choose. The cake takes two days.
